text: Murprotec operates in France through MURPROTEC SA (RCS Paris B 301 499 042, capital 100,000 EUR, 40 rue de Trévise, Paris), whose site is published by Garry Ordener, Directeur France, Groupe MURPROTEC; the club's partner page states the company is part of Groupe Murprotec International.
short: Murprotec France is MURPROTEC SA (RCS Paris B 301 499 042), part of Groupe Murprotec International.
